0b209d8e0a.headline: How to Get the Crabshack VF5 SMG in GTA 6
0b209d8e0a.full_caption:
Crab-themed SMG, free jet ski and a giant crab lurking in the swamp. 🦀

The optional Pelican Valley Outpost event is worth the boat trip. Besides the Crabshack VF5 SMG, you get some cash and a jet ski for the ride home. Swipe for the route, and watch out for gators.

Have you cleared the outpost yet, and did you spot the giant crab?

Source: Polygon

#GTA6 #GTAVI #GrandTheftAuto6 #Leonida #RockstarGames #GTA6Guide #GTA6Tips #CrabshackVF5 #PelicanValleyOutpost #Gaming
0b209d8e0a.alt_text: Graphic with the headline about finding the Crabshack VF5 SMG and the giant crab outpost in GTA 6.

slides.title: Getting to the island
slides.text: Look for a medium-sized island southwest of the "Pelican Valley" label on the map. Take Jason's boat from his house and don't swim: there are too many gators.

slides.title: Power and password
slides.text: The first shack has no power. Flip the breaker box behind it, near the blue crab cages. The computer password is in the small bedroom, and the computer holds a note pointing to the safe code.

slides.title: Crab, lab and safe
slides.text: Karkinos, the giant crab, jumps you in a short cutscene, but there's no fight. The lab behind the shack has the experiment list you need for the code. The safe holds cash and a note with the next code.

slides.title: Your rewards
slides.text: That second code opens the boathouse keypad. Inside you can grab the Crabshack VF5 SMG and a bag of marked bills for Brian's lockup. A free jet ski gets you home.

e4fdbd4ad1.headline: GTA 6 launch drove Comcast's biggest traffic day ever
e4fdbd4ad1.full_caption:
GTA 6 just broke the internet, or at least a big chunk of Comcast's network. 📈

Comcast says November 19 was the busiest traffic day in its network history, with traffic 31% above an average day. At peak, it says GTA 6 made up nearly a quarter of all traffic on its network.

Note that this covers Comcast's network, not the whole internet.

Were you part of the download rush on day one?

Source: PC Gamer

#GTA6 #GrandTheftAuto6 #GTAVI #RockstarGames #Leonida #Comcast #GamingNews #VideoGames #GTAOnline #GamingCommunity
e4fdbd4ad1.alt_text: News graphic reading that GTA 6's launch drove Comcast's biggest internet traffic day in its network history.

slides.title: A record day for Comcast
slides.text: Comcast says November 19 was the highest-traffic day in its network's history. Traffic climbed 31% above an average day, and the company ties the surge to GTA 6's launch.

slides.title: Nearly a quarter at peak
slides.text: At the peak, Comcast says GTA 6 accounted for nearly a quarter of all traffic on its network. The company shared a line graph showing the spike, labeled only with the date.

slides.title: Network, not the whole internet
slides.text: PC Gamer points out that Comcast's network isn't the same as the entire internet. The figures come from Comcast's own post on X, so treat them as that company's data.
